title: yml→pkl importer should lift SUFeedURL/SUPublicEDKey info properties into typed ReleaseIdentity
description: Both hello-world demo upgrades (2026-07-16) produced project.pkl files where the Sparkle facts survive ONLY as untyped Info.plist properties (targets[...].info.properties SUFeedURL / SUPublicEDKey / SUEnableAutomaticChecks / SUScheduledCheckInterval) while `releaseIdentity` evaluates to null. The schema's typed home for exactly these facts (ReleaseIdentity.sparkleFeedURL / .sparklePublicEDKey, AppleProjectSpec.pkl class ReleaseIdentity) exists but the importer never populates it. Consequence: the pkl exemplar of the fully proven Sparkle pipeline carries its update identity outside the typed contract, and generate-sparkle-config (which reads releaseIdentity) cannot operate on imported app manifests. Sparkle truth should live once, typed, and project the INFOPLIST_KEY_SU* build settings from there.
design: Importer maps SUFeedURL → releaseIdentity.sparkleFeedURL and SUPublicEDKey → releaseIdentity.sparklePublicEDKey (plus shortVersion from MARKETING_VERSION when present). Decide the single-source rule: either the importer REMOVES the lifted SU* keys from info.properties (generator re-emits them from releaseIdentity, as it already does for app targets), or it keeps both and the generator asserts they agree — pick the first unless parity constraints force the second, and gate disagreement loudly either way.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running the hello-world.demo upgrade yields releaseIdentity.sparkleFeedURL == "https://vapor-wares.pages.dev/appcast/hello-world.xml" and the matching public key, with generate-xcodeproj output settings unchanged (parity suites green); a manifest where info.properties and releaseIdentity disagree is a loud typed error.
notes: Found by the hello-world pkl-exemplar slice under beads/FR-CLI-SPARKLE-SELF-UPDATE-VAPORIZE-PKL-SCAFFOLDER-2026-07-14 (mono root). Related: that umbrella's descoped Stage-Appcast-Draft stub replacement also reads releaseIdentity — this lift is its prerequisite for imported manifests.
